title: Subspace Fourier vanishing
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $A$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. If $\gamma$ is not orthogonal to every vector in $A$ under the standard dot product, then the Fourier coefficient at $\gamma$ of the indicator function of $A$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $\gamma$ is not in the orthogonal subspace of $A$
